name: PL-NeRF Volumetric Rendering
definition: A NeRF implementation using piecewise linear opacity interpolation and precise importance sampling, replacing the constant approximation used in vanilla NeRF.
summary: PL-NeRF replaces vanilla NeRF's constant opacity with piecewise linear interpolation and precise importance sampling to solve quadrature instability and enable accurate integration of arbitrarily small opacity values.
